label: Personal Loans / Debt Consolidation

angle: no impact to your credit score

niche_match.note: An ad is on-niche if `include` matches after `exclude` phrases are stripped. Ads selling TO loan officers/brokers (recruiting, CRM software, leads-for-sale) are B2B, not competitors, and are excluded too. Mortgage-specific and payday-specific ads will match here too since the wording overlaps heavily with personal loans / debt consolidation — tighten `include`/`exclude` once you've seen a week of real results and know which adjacent verticals are noise for you.

notes: Starter config — seed_pages is intentionally empty. Add known competitor Facebook Page names (not URLs, not IDs — harvest.mjs resolves names to IDs itself and caches them) as you identify them from the keyword sweep's own results. Re-check keywords after the first run: read raw/ads-01.json and see what off-niche noise the discovery keywords pulled in, then tighten niche_match.exclude.
